title: 車輪在軌鏇削設備
summary: 本課聚焦輪對在軌加工的幾何材料去除與量測。從輪徑與切削線速度建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把加工設備穩態熱路與輪廓量測誤差合成連成可驗證的介面，最後以輪型與缺陷案例矩陣整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies geometry material removal and measurement in underfloor wheel machining. Start with wheel diameter and cutting speed to define physical or information boundaries, connect steady heat paths in machining equipment with combining profile-measurement uncertainty as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through wheel-type and defect case matrix. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創整合工作單，所有輸入均為教學假設而非代表工程實測：先研究輪徑與切削線速度。原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。公式 y=pi*D*rpm，代入得 y=158.336 m/min。邊界：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。敏感度只改 D=0.84 至 0.924 m，輸出變為 174.17 m/min；離散計數採整數變化。再獨立研究徑向去除與壽命帳：原創假想教學輸入：原始輪徑 D0=840 mm；單側徑向去除 depth=1.5 mm。公式 y=D0-2*depth，代入得 y=837 mm。邊界：同心均勻去除的幾何帳，不包含輪廓規範或最小使用輪徑。兩個結果不能因同一課程就任意相加，必須先確認單位、因果順序及共同邊界。本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。最後提出一項量測能區分模型假設失效與儀器偏差，將輸入表、重算結果和適用限制一併交付。
workedExample.textEn: Original integrated worksheet; every input is a teaching assumption rather than a measurement from a reference project. First investigate wheel diameter and cutting speed. Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Formula y=pi*D*rpm gives y=158.336 m/min. Boundary: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings. For sensitivity, change only D=0.84 to 0.924 m; the output becomes 174.17 m/min. Discrete counts use whole-number steps. Independently investigate radial removal and life accounting: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: initial diameter D0=840 mm; radial removal per side depth=1.5 mm. Formula y=D0-2*depth gives y=837 mm. Boundary: Geometric accounting for concentric uniform removal; profile rules and minimum service diameter are not specified. Results cannot be added merely because they belong to the same course: check units, causal sequence and shared boundaries first. Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Propose one measurement distinguishing a failed model assumption from instrument bias, and deliver the input table, recomputed results and applicability limits together.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 輪徑與切削線速度與徑向去除與壽命帳
stages.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed & Radial removal and life accounting
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「輪徑與切削線速度」與「徑向去除與壽命帳」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wheel diameter and cutting speed" and "Radial removal and life accounting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「輪徑與切削線速度」如何影響車輪在軌鏇削設備的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Underfloor wheel-lathe systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元比較磨耗前後輪徑對接觸線速度的影響，分開驅動滾輪轉速與真正輪對轉速。切削線速度由輪徑與轉速共同決定，相同轉速在不同直徑會造成不同刀具接觸條件。輪對鏇削還要考慮夾持剛度、材料硬點和輪廓基準；把工具轉速設定正確，並不能保證完成後輪廓與同軸度符合需求。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪徑與切削線速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compare contact-speed changes before and after diameter wear, separating drive-roller speed from actual wheelset rotation. Cutting surface speed depends on diameter and rotational speed, so the same rotation rate produces different tool conditions on different wheels. Reprofiling also depends on clamping stiffness, hard spots and profile reference. Correct speed setting does not by itself establish final profile or concentricity. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輪徑改變時固定轉速仍會維持相同切削線速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fixed rotational speed maintains the same cutting speed when wheel diameter changes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「輪徑與切削線速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wheel diameter and cutting speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：輪徑改變時固定轉速仍會維持相同切削線速度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fixed rotational speed maintains the same cutting speed when wheel diameter changes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪徑與切削線速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：輪徑 D=0.84 m；轉速 rpm=60 rev/min。公式 y=pi*D*rpm，代入得 y=158.336 m/min。邊界：幾何線速度換算，未指定刀具材料或實際切削參數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: wheel diameter D=0.84 m; rotational speed rpm=60 rev/min. Formula y=pi*D*rpm gives y=158.336 m/min. Boundary: Geometric surface-speed conversion without specifying tool material or production cutting settings. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪徑與切削線速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實際輪徑核對轉速回授，將加工前後的輪廓掃描、圓度與刀具磨耗分開記錄。以「輪徑與切削線速度」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check rotation feedback against measured diameter and record pre/post profile, roundness and tool wear separately. For wheel diameter and cutting speed, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把輪徑 D 從 0.84 改成 0.924 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 158.336 變為 174.17 m/min。先說明「輪徑與切削線速度」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only wheel diameter D from 0.84 to 0.924 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 158.336 to 174.17 m/min. Explain the causal direction for wheel diameter and cutting speed, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以標稱輪徑代替磨耗後直徑會錯估速度，輪面滑動則使驅動滾輪轉速不再代表輪對轉速。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominal instead of worn diameter biases speed; roller slip makes drive-roller rotation differ from wheelset rotation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 輪徑與切削線速度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel diameter and cutting speed: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪徑與切削線速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel diameter and cutting speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以標稱輪徑代替磨耗後直徑會錯估速度，輪面滑動則使驅動滾輪轉速不再代表輪對轉速。回到「輪徑與切削線速度」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal instead of worn diameter biases speed; roller slip makes drive-roller rotation differ from wheelset rotation. Trace the input chain for wheel diameter and cutting speed. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以矩形切屑類比計算去除率，另外計入檢測與重工時間以免只追求刀具接觸時間最短。體積去除率由截面乘相對進給估算，能用來連結節拍、切屑與能量需求。增加去除率會同時提高熱與力的負擔，實際效果受刀具、材料與剛度限制；縮短加工時間若造成重工，總維修週期反而可能增加。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：矩形切屑截面的概念估算，非輪廓加工刀路與實際參數建議。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切屑體積與節拍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a rectangular-chip analogy to estimate removal rate and separately include inspection and rework rather than minimizing tool-contact time alone. Higher removal increases thermal and mechanical loading, limited by tooling, material and stiffness. A shorter cut can lengthen the total maintenance cycle when it creates rework. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Chip volume and processing cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: cutting width width=6 mm; cut thickness depth=0.4 mm; relative feed speed feed=100 mm/s. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
